spec.name: Flat Oval Paper Lantern Pendant Shade
spec.proportions: Approximately 70 cm diameter and 30 cm height, presenting a flattened oval profile with a 7:3 width-to-height ratio.

parts.material: Translucent washi paper over fine wire ribbing

details: Horizontal ribbing texture running concentrically around the shade
Visible subtle fibrous texture in the paper skin
Oblate elliptical contour with open top and bottom apertures
spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist flat oval paper pendant lantern shade measuring 70 cm in diameter and 30 cm in height. The oblate spheroid body is crafted from fibrous, translucent off-white washi paper (#cac7c3, #bcb6af) stretched over a fine spiral bamboo wire framework, producing delicate horizontal ribbing and subtle shadowed banding (#aa9e90, #998772). It features small circular openings at the top and base, with soft diffuse illumination filtering through the matte textured surface.
